John Brennan decreased its stake in Union Pac Corp (UNP) by 38.75% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sirios Capital Management LP sold 188,179 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.36% with the market. The hedge fund run by John Brennan held 297,473 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $39.89M, down from 485,652 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sirios Capital Management LP who had been investing in Union Pac Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $104.86 billion market cap company. The stock increased 2.28% or $3.02 during the last trading session, reaching $135.2. About 3.63M shares traded. Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP) has risen 26.23% since April 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.68% the S&P500.
